description.value: The heads of these rounds glow in a variety of neon colors. When you hit with this ammunition, the target is coated in phosphorescent chemicals until the start of your next turn. The target isn't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] due to dim lighting, and if it would be hidden or undetected due to darkness or invisibility, it's concealed instead. If you critically hit the target, it's instead fully visible in dim light or darkness and has any invisibility @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] until the start of your next turn.
